leads.claim: A magnesium alloy specimen, alleged to be from a 1947 crashed extraterrestrial vehicle, was analyzed to determine if it was of terrestrial origin or a THz waveguide.
leads.why: The document explicitly details the government's (AARO) engagement with a national laboratory (ORNL) to analyze a specific physical specimen claimed to be of extraterrestrial origin.
leads.custody_chain: AARO contracted with ORNL for analysis; the specimen's history is described as undocumented and unverifiable.
leads.government_response: AARO and ORNL conducted isotopic and structural analysis, concluding the material is terrestrial and not a waveguide.
leads.quote: This specimen has been publicly alleged to be a component recovered from a crashed extraterrestrial vehicle in 1947

doc_verdict: The document confirms the government analyzed a specific physical specimen alleged to be of extraterrestrial origin, but concludes it is a mundane terrestrial material.
